name: The Glasswalk
world_constraints: Campaign rules: Luck is PC-only; all NPC current/max Luck and rank Luck bonuses are0. Classic Fantasy Imperative combat: repeat initiative cycles while usable AP remain, one proactive Action per TURN not per round. Delay conserves actions, paid when used. Engaged Regain Footing costs1AP and requires opposed Brawn or Athletics; no rank exemption. Nearby dropped weapon recovery costs2Actions (reach then ready). Fightingwhileprone is Formidable. Rank4 CFI AP=2base+2rank=4. Track specific mastery free parries/ripostes distinctly; do not doublecharge them. No free standing or pickup.
description: Tiled working roofs and a stone pedestrian bridge above a narrow canal, adjoining Furnace Court.
staging_notes: SENSE: claws ring on tile, canal water against stone. SHAPE: east stair ->12x8m terrace ->12m bridge2mwide/3mhigh -> west storehouse landing/downstair/roofladder; waist-high parapet. Canal4mwide/2mdeep, ladder each side. HANDS: chimneys, shutters, bridge rail. COSTS: exposed crossing with solid footing; ordinary movement no roll unless contested/rushing hazardous edge. TURNS: blocked bridge leaves canal, roof and stairs. KEY: blue light through moving glass.
